summary: Self-gated: the change reorders SSTable component file deletion in SSTable.delete() by last-modified timestamp. It adds no input parsing, tenant isolation, authn/authz, network endpoint, or secrets handling. File paths still come from the internal Descriptor and Component set, with no new untrusted input. No security findings. (Behavior notes outside this lens: FileUtils.delete replaces deleteWithConfirm, and a missing file reports lastModified 0. The spec and correctness lenses should weigh these.)
tests_detail: not run: review-only lens (security lens runs no tests)
